name: 穆鲁的哀鸣
description: 自动弃置所有圣光手牌。每弃置1张，对所有敌人造成3点真实伤害并为友方治疗2点生命，最多分别结算到6点和6点。若弃置3张以上，所有友方获得圣盾。
targetText: 全体敌人 / 全体友方
code: function executeSkill(context) { const caster = context.piece; const battle = context.battle; const player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === caster.ownerPlayerId; }); const holyCards = player.hand.filter(function(c) { return c.cardId && c.cardId.startsWith('holy-'); }); const cardCount = holyCards.length; if (cardCount === 0) { return { success: false, message: '没有圣光手牌' }; } holyCards.forEach(function(card) { discardCard(card.instanceId); }); const enemies = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); const allies = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId === caster.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); const dmgPerTarget = Math.min(3 * cardCount, 6); const dmgResult = dealDamage(caster, enemies, dmgPerTarget, 'true', battle, 'muru-lament'); const totalDamage = dmgResult.totalDamage || 0; const hlResult = healDamage(caster, allies, 2 * cardCount, battle, 'muru-lament'); const totalHeal = hlResult.totalHeal || 0; if (cardCount >= 3) { allies.forEach(function(ally) { addStatusEffectById(ally.instanceId, { id: 'divine-shield', type: 'divine-shield', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-divine-shield'] }); addRuleById(ally.instanceId, 'rule-divine-shield'); }); } return { message: caster.name + '释放穆鲁的哀鸣！弃置' + cardCount + '张圣光手牌，对所有敌人造成' + totalDamage + '点伤害，友方恢复' + totalHeal + '生命' + (cardCount >= 3 ? '，全体获得圣盾！' : ''), success: true }; }
